title: [DEMO SCENARIO] Cyclone Alert: Bay of Bengal System
description: DEMO SCENARIO: Deep depression over west-central Bay of Bengal intensifying into a cyclonic storm. Gale winds up to 90 km/h and heavy coastal rain projected along Kakinada and Konaseema coast. Fishermen advised not to venture into sea.

title: [DEMO SCENARIO] Godavari & Krishna Riparian Flood Advisory
description: DEMO SCENARIO: High upstream inflows increasing barrage discharge. Low-lying riparian settlements in East Godavari and Krishna districts advised to monitor local advisories and avoid submerged causeways.

title: [DEMO SCENARIO] Coastal Inundation Advisory - Lowland Causeways
description: DEMO SCENARIO: High astronomical tide combined with moderate coastal swells may cause localized waterlogging along Uppada Beach Road and coastal village access roads.
affectedArea: Uppada Beach Corridor, Kakinada District, AP
